distributor.name: Sol Plaatje Local Municipality Electricity Department

approved_increase.notes: Kimberley. PROPOSED: 8% pending. Recheck 2026-07-05: budget was DELAYED late June 2026 after residents opposed new electricity charges, then delivered week of 2 July with the 8% still pending, plus mayoral proposals: 2.5 percentage-point discount for domestic and registered indigent customers (effective ~5.5% for qualifying households), indigent income threshold raised R4,500 to R6,000/month, and basic/capacity charges to apply only to supplies of 40A and above. No NERSA-approved final figure found.
